Evidence tiers

Claims in the app are tagged by how well-supported they are, so nothing reads as more authoritative than it actually is.

  • Peer-reviewed

    Backed by published, peer-reviewed research.

  • Coaching heuristic

    A widely used rule of thumb from experienced coaches — useful, but not scientifically validated.

  • Community data

    Informal, crowdsourced information — not vetted by research or coaching expertise.
